scientific_integrity: The four strict witness differences and 4,060-case finite census are exact; no claim of universal bound beyond the tested finite range, no claim of empirical prevalence, and no externally independent validation.
scientific_limitations: An exact all-combinations without-replacement incidence statement; the sharp threshold is for exactly two observed species and up to 29 sites. The two witness turns are very small; no stochastic detectability or ecological-process inference follows. Independent validation and audit have not been performed.
title: A sharp 29-site threshold for two turning points in two-species zeta retention
